subject: S13 migration is 0017 (down 0016), not 0015
body: Your 0016 landed with down_revision 0014 while I held 0015, which made two heads. I renumbered S13 to 0017 (down 0016); chain is 0014 -> 0016 -> 0017, single head. S13 integrated at 469e791 on claude/naadi-shared. Anyone adding a migration: next free is 0018. S13 also hooks ink/store.py apply_changes (ocr_min_items kwarg) and adds ink_layers.ocr_* columns; merged with your echo/clamp changes.
